ai.title: StoryOS
ai.panelDescription: One conversation per project, stored in memory only
ai.greetingHint: Pick a quick action to start, or type your request directly
ai.breakdownScriptDesc: Provide a novel or story text, specify episodes and duration, AI quickly splits into complete episode scripts
ai.designStoryboardDesc: Auto-generate storyboard scripts from screenplay, including shot descriptions, angles, camera moves and dialogue annotations
ai.assetAnalysisDesc: Auto-extract characters, scenes and props from the script, generate a complete production asset list
ai.breakdownScriptPrompt: Break down the current script into shots by scene, marking character appearances, visual descriptions, and the corresponding source text positions.

ai.qaScriptWriteDesc: Generate a full episode script from an outline or synopsis

ai.qaScriptAnalyzeDesc: Analyze the three-act structure, pacing and turning points

ai.qaScriptDialogueDesc: Refine character dialogue to make each voice distinctive
ai.qaScriptDialoguePrompt: Polish the dialogue in the current episode, making each character's speaking style more distinctive and natural.
ai.qaStoryboardSplitDesc: Break the script into a storyboard shot list
ai.qaStoryboardSplitPrompt: Break the current episode script into storyboard shots, with shot type, camera movement and scene description for each.
ai.qaStoryboardOptimizeDesc: Analyze and improve the visual language of existing shots
ai.qaStoryboardOptimizePrompt: Analyze the current storyboard's shot language and optimize framing, camera movement and composition for better visual storytelling.
ai.qaStoryboardTransitionPrompt: Design transitions between shots in the current storyboard, considering emotional pacing and narrative continuity.
ai.qaCharacterExtractDesc: Automatically extract all characters from the script
ai.qaCharacterExtractPrompt: Extract all characters from the current script, generating name, personality description and visual traits for each.
ai.qaCharacterDesignDesc: Generate detailed visual descriptions for existing characters
ai.qaCharacterDesignPrompt: Generate detailed visual descriptions (appearance, clothing, signature features) for all characters in the project for AI image generation.
ai.qaCharacterRelationPrompt: Map out all character relationships in the project, including hierarchies, conflicts, and emotional bonds.
ai.qaSceneCreateDesc: Extract and batch create scenes from the script
ai.qaSceneCreatePrompt: Extract all scenes from the current script, generate name, environment description and atmosphere for each, then batch create them.
ai.qaSceneAnalyzeDesc: Analyze scene frequency and distribution across episodes
ai.qaSceneAnalyzePrompt: Analyze scene usage across the project, count frequency of each scene, and find shots missing scene settings.
ai.qaSceneAtmosphereDesc: Add detailed atmosphere and visual descriptions to scenes
ai.qaSceneAtmospherePrompt: Design detailed atmosphere descriptions for all scenes, including lighting, color palette, weather and emotional tone.

ai.qaAdScriptPrompt: I want to create a product ad. Please learn about the product first, then help me write a 30-second ad script.
ai.qaAdStoryboardDesc: Break the ad script into an actionable storyboard
